label: warehouse-export
command: import json,os,psycopg; from mdm.snowflake import export_snapshot; c=psycopg.connect(os.environ['MDM_DATABASE_URL']); c.execute('SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY'); s=export_snapshot(c); print(json.dumps({'snapshot_id':s.snapshot_id,'counts':s.counts,'postgres_export_executed':True,'snowflake_load_executed':False})); c.close()
